description: Genre pack: Risograph / 70s–80s print revival. Warm paper, pigment inks (one red + one blue maximum), halftone dot textures, misregistered ink offsets, rubber-stamp details, poster typography. Use for zines, events, agencies, food/drink brands, music, and anything wanting a warm analog voice. Stack on the design-taste core skill.
